intelligence.human_view: He looked at the sidebar and said: these icons look like circles, and the square ones look a little flat. He was hoping for the sharp icons from the bottom bar — the ones that already look like real objects. And it's not just the sidebar: many buttons still look very flat. Try to make none of them look flat. Master the elevating — every input, every icon, every button, every button inside a button — everything real and clear, pro level, in clarity. The flow around the profile picture is pretty flat and doesn't look real; it could be enhanced in its presentation, its quality, its elegance. And then he gave the image that holds it all: you're putting their picture on a pedestal, you're putting icons on a pedestal, you're putting the boards and the buttons on a pedestal. Raised above. A higher level of quality, elegance, object. Beauty in their objectuality and their physicality. Digital assets made works of art — made to feel real, and to be useful and helpful in the operations of NayaNET. A pedestal is not decoration. It is the statement that this thing matters enough to be lifted up where you can see it properly.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine all your favorite toys — but instead of lying flat on the floor, each one sits up on its own little pedestal, like in a museum! The picture sits up high, the icons sit up high, the buttons sit up high — everything raised up so you can see how beautiful and real they are! Nothing flat, nothing squished down — everything standing tall and proud, like a work of art!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine everything on the page sitting up on its own little pedestal, dear, like beautiful things in a shop window! The picture, the icons, the boards, the buttons — all raised up high, so you can see how real and lovely they are, love! Nothing flat, nothing dull — everything standing proud like a work of art, made to feel real and be useful, dear!
intelligence.naya_view: NOTHING FLAT, EVERYTHING A REAL OBJECT. Sidebar icons are CIRCLES — the sharp bottom-bar form, harvested verbatim, never squares by default (a square only where it genuinely fits better; never flat). The profile picture gets the PEDESTAL — elevated as a real object, rim in its own deep color, slow orbit flowing around it. MASTER ELEVATION covers every button, input, icon, board, and button-within-a-button — a button inside a button is its own object with its own elevation, never a flat mark on its parent. A FLAT ELEMENT IS A DEFECT, whatever else it does. The checker walks the page at 390px and 1920px and names every element that still reads flat; the round is not done until that list is empty.
